page: Google Cloud Platform z3-highmem-176-standardlssd belongs to the storage-optimized family, configured with 176 dedicated vCPUs across 88 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8481C processor clocked at 2.7 GHz. Utilizing the x86_64 architecture, the processor features 48 KB of L1d cache, 2 MB of L2 cache, and a large 105 MB L3 cache. It incorporates advanced instruction sets including Intel AMX (amx_tile, amx_int8) and AVX-512 extensions (AVX-512 VNNI and BF16) to accelerate matrix operations and cryptography. Memory capacity is substantial at 1408 GB, providing an 8 GB allocation per vCPU. Storage is bundled via 12 local NVMe SSDs providing 38652 GB of raw capacity. No dedicated GPU hardware is included.

Benchmark data demonstrates top-tier multi-threaded compute capability, as shown by a stress-ng multi-core score of 145909.0 and a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rate of 797.8 GB/sec. Large-block memory bandwidth benchmarks reach 445.54 GB/sec for read operations and 191.27 GB/sec for write operations, reflecting high data throughput capabilities. In application-focused metrics, the instance achieves top-tier results in Redis SET throughput at 160.82 million operations per second and static web serving throughput of 120.27 GB/sec. Ray tracing and image processing tasks also record top-decile scores, while single-threaded tasks align closer to industry averages.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the instance provides high qualitative economic value for consolidated enterprise environments requiring high compute density alongside extensive memory and low-latency storage. The dense combination of 176 vCPUs, 1.4 TB of RAM, and over 38 TB of NVMe SSDs eliminates the need to distribute workloads across multiple smaller nodes, reducing network overhead. However, the architectural tradeoff involves average single-core CPU throughput and the absence of discrete GPU acceleration. The server is suited for high-throughput distributed transactional databases, real-time analytics engines, in-memory key-value stores, and extensive ETL pipelines.
description: Google Cloud Platform z3-highmem-176-standardlssd is a storage-optimized virtual instance powered by Intel Xeon 8481C processors running on the x86_64 architecture. The server delivers 176 dedicated vCPUs across 88 physical cores clocked at 2.7 GHz, paired with 1408 GB of system memory and 38652 GB of bundled high-speed local NVMe SSD storage. While lacking hardware GPU accelerators, the instance incorporates Intel AMX and AVX-512 instruction sets, supporting advanced vector computations and CPU-based matrix operations. Benchmark results show top-tier multi-threaded CPU performance alongside massive memory bandwidth and high Redis throughput reaching 160.82 million operations per second. With an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio and direct local NVMe capacity, this configuration offers high qualitative resource density for massive datasets. The instance is designed for large-scale distributed databases, in-memory caching systems, big data analytics, and high-concurrency enterprise workloads.
